turns.prompt_text: what can you use to get rust off of metal
turns.response_html: You can use household items like white vinegar, baking soda paste, or a mixture of lemon juice and salt for natural removal, or you can use commercial chemical rust removers and rust converter products. For heavy rust, mechanical removal with a wire brush or sanding may be necessary.
